name: Gen'ei Sentai Misty Knights
source:
Hero is the general of an army who has finally succeeded in capturing all four misty knights girls. Now it's the time to get every single secret from them, with force if needed.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
英雄是一位军队的将军，他终于成功俘虏了所有四名迷雾骑士少女。现在是从他们那里获取每一个秘密的时候了，如果需要的话可以使用武力。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
